Mark every object reachable from a live commit or pin and rewrite archives whose dead share justifies it

```sh
goback [global flags] gc [flags]
```

| Flag | Description | Environment | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--readers value` | parallel object reads during the mark |  | `32` |
| `--dead-ratio value` | rewrite an archive once this share of its bytes is dead |  | `0.3` |
| `--erasure-bound value` | rewrite an archive that has held dead objects this long regardless of ratio |  | `336h0m0s` |
| `--min-age value` | never drop an object younger than this |  | `24h0m0s` |
| `--no-sweep` | mark only |  |  |
| `--temp-dir value` | directory for the live-set runs; defaults to the system temp dir |  |  |
